summary: Keep coalesced filesystem subtree notifications scoped to declared inputs

schema.detail: No claim or projection format changes.

compatibility.detail: FSEvents MustScanSubDirs notifications retain their subtree scope rather than invalidating every subscription and waking the common reconciliation loop. Declared inputs and canonical referents intersecting the subtree are reread through their existing reader routes. UserDropped, KernelDropped, event-ID wrap and unknown/pathless rescans remain conservative stream-wide invalidations. No debounce or polling is introduced.

manual.detail: No configuration or repair is required.
